title: Somnigroup International Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Somnigroup International Inc. (NYSE: SGI, "Company") announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026 and revised financial guidance for the full year 2026. SECOND QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL SUMMARY Total net sales decreased 3.0% to $1,823.5 million as compared to $1,880.8 million in the second quarter of 2025. Gross margin was 44.8% as compared to 44.0% in the second quarter of 2025. Adjusted gross margin (1) was 45.1% as compared to 44.2% in the second quarter of 2025. Operating income increased 12.1% to $201.7 million as compared to $179.9 million in the second quarter of 2025. Adjusted operating income (1) decreased 3.5% to $216.6 million as compared to $224.4 million in the second quarter of 2025. Net income increased 12.0% to $110.9 million as compared to $99.0 million in the second quarter of 2025.
